items.item_text: 6. Ability to participate in safety training/certification programs.
Possession of valid Class C California Driver's License without restrictions and maintenance of a satisfactory driving record.
Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Age Requirement: Candidate(s) must be 18 years or older to be eligible to be hired.
Driving Record: The position is subject to the
California DMV "Pull Notice System"
and continued employment is contingent upon proof of a satisfactory driving record.

Under the general supervision of the Principal Auto Equipment-Supervisor, provide driver services of paratransit van(s), light duty vehicles, passenger vans, and/or cars to transport students, staff, and faculty, including those with permanent and temporary mobility impairments, needing assistance getting to/from campus locations and adjacent residential areas on scheduled routes.
Knowledge of driving laws as specified in the California Vehicle Code.
Knowledge of UCLA campus and adjacent areas to ensure most effective routes for pick-up and drop-off destinations.
1. Skill in the safe operation of various passenger vehicles to provide transportation as directed.
11. Ability to handle complex procedures on electric vehicle charging and monitoring.
2. Skill in establishing/maintaining tactful relationships with supervisors, passengers, co-workers.
12. Ability to operate wheelchair lifts, ramps and other special equipment.
3. Skill in relaying information to passengers politely, clearly, and effectively.
4. Ability to use two-way radio and/or cellular phone for communication purposes in a professional manner and utilizing proper etiquette.
5. Ability to maintain accurate, legible logs and records.
7. Ability to detect irregular vehicle performance in order to recognize required maintenance or repairs.
8. Ability to maintain excellent attendance and punctuality in order to meet specific deadlines.
9. Ability to use electronic mapping and navigational tools and Thomas Guide for selecting event routing.
10. Ability to safely interact with trip scheduling software.

pay.source_text: The budgeted hiring salary/target range for this position is from the posted minimum to $25 hourly, with salary placement based on skills, knowledge, and experience.
